page.layout: One page of text. At the head: running title "PARS SECVNDA." left of centre and page number "171" at the top right. Below them, two coin medallions side by side, with their legends. Then one paragraph beginning "BALDVINVS", then one paragraph beginning "HENRICVS". Below the text, a decorative ornament without printed text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: BALDVINVS, Flandriæ Comes, ab omni milite, & exercitu,Flandrensi scilicet,Montisferratensi,Allobrogum & Venetorum , Imperator Constantinopolitanus creatur post Alexium iuniorem anno mundi 5162. à Christo nato 1200. hac conditione vt si ex Francis designaretur Imperator,Veneti Patriarcham darent: quod & euenit. Balduinus cuncta præter Adrianopolim recepit:in qua imperauit Theodorus,. Alexij Imperatoris pessimi gener, quam & nomine dotis accepit. Cum Franci eam obsiderent ac prope expugnarent,captus & mortuus est Balduinus,qui annum imperio vix præfuerat. Vide Egna.lib.2.Ro.prin.& Cosm.Mun.lib.4.

HENRICVS Balduini frater,Imperator post eius mortem creatur, anno mundi 5163.à Christo nato 1201. Hic expugnationem Adrianopolitanam persequitur, ac repetit: sed irruentibus Saracenis, obsidionem soluit: Constantinopolim rediit, quam & munit. Fœdere cum Valachis firmato, & filia Ducis eorum in vxorem ducta,domi,forisque cum prudenter se Henricus gereret, Gulielmum Bonifacij filium, Regem Thessaliæ designat. mox moriens, Iolantem filiam, Petro Altisiodorensi nuptam, hæredem relinquit,anno imperij 13. Vide vt supra.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are only partly legible. The left coin reads "FLANDR." and "BALDVINVS". The right coin reads "HENRI" and, on the left, "CVSA" with the last letter doubtful, probably the end of HENRICVS. The decorative ornament below the text carries no printed words and is not transcribed. The text is printed with the spelling "vt", "vxorem" and "ducta", which I have kept as printed in the transcription. The printed "vt" and "vxorem" may need normalising to ut and uxorem under the house rules.
